card.name: Space before a number in formulas
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right before a numeric value in a reference table or conversion formula, such as a specific heat value, an iron content per mL, or a lab equation constant.

modes.label: Property table values
modes.description: Space before a number after a physical property label in an element data table.

modes.label: Conversion formula quantities
modes.description: Space before a quantity in a formula that relates volume, mass or amount.
modes.example: contains<< >>1 mg of elemental iron. INFe

modes.label: Digits in dose or lab equations
modes.description: A digit inside a concentration range or an osmolality equation.

card.plain: It fires just before a number in a data table or formula, where a measured amount is about to be given.
